newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northern Trust EPS up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northern Trust EPS up.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Tuesday it raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Northern Trust Corp to $2.55 a share from $2.50 to account for higher than expected first quarter earnings.
-- On Monday, Northern Trust reported net income of $0.62 a share, up from $0.52. Everen said earnings beat its estimate of $0.59 a share and the consensus forecast of $0.60.
-- The 1998 estimate of $2.85 a share is unchanged.
-- It reiterated its outperform rating on the bank.
-- Northern Trust shares were up 7/16 at 39-5/8.
